name: session-viewer
description: Scan, inspect, and compare local Codex sessions in a private, read-only browser dashboard.

interface.longDescription: Launches a local-only, read-only dashboard that scans active and archived Codex sessions. It reports system prompt character and estimated token counts, compares two instruction stacks with highlighted differences, and presents each turn as query, thinking, tool calls, and tool results.
defaultPrompt: Launch the local session trace dashboard
